purpose: Bounded two-agent pilot on DGX Spark local Qwen3.8 Flash Next endpoints once endpoint details are supplied.

worktree_policy.implementation_agent: one disposable worktree branched from the operator-approved integration base
worktree_policy.review_agent: separate disposable worktree at the same immutable base
worktree_policy.merge: operator/root only after both agent receipts and review pass

tasks.objective: Implement the already-reviewed regional force-correction diagnostic from commit 1f49f47, preserving read-only diagnostic semantics and producing no PDE acceptance claim.
tasks.scope: clock-512 N384 M384-versus-M512 force-grid delta on the fixed unshifted M768 lattice and five exclusive sampled regions
required_math: triangle bounds for each RMS channel
triangle bounds for each peak channel
floor-normalized peak bounds using identical fixed archived floors
no vector alignment, cancellation, or inferred direction

tasks.objective: Independently review the implementation diff, source/tests, resource preflight, immutable-input binding, and output semantics before any heavy execution.
tasks.scope: review only; no implementation and no numerical run
checks: triangle RMS and peak bounds are mathematically valid
fixed floors are byte/hash bound and identical
read-only diagnostic and excluded claims are explicit
resource and wall limits precede work
receipt hashes and unperformed work are recorded

evidence_contract.format: JSON receipt plus SHA256SUMS and human README
evidence_contract.endpoint_privacy: record a stable redacted endpoint identity or local transport label; never record credentials
evidence_contract.failure: preserve partial logs and receipt; classify refusal, timeout, transport failure, or semantic failure
evidence_contract.acceptance: receipt completeness and independent review only; numerical/PDE acceptance remains outside this pilot

authority.cloud_fallback_or_scope_change: forbidden without a new explicit authorization
